limitations: RSS is resident set size in KiB (ps rss), not physical footprint; shared/model pages may be counted more than once.
CPU is cumulative process-time delta (ps time=) over the process's observed window, not the instantaneous %CPU ps reports.
cpu-time resolution is 0.01 s; no wakeups and no per-thread/energy measurement.
This is a live observation of the running fleet, not a controlled idle lab test; other processes and builds may contend.
A process that starts or stops during sampling is measured only over its observed window.
footprint(1) is a single reading per process, not a leak test.
Read-only contract: no root, no process restarts/signals, no network, no screenshots, no screen/private captures.
Service discovery uses full argv in memory only; the JSON carries safe labels (pid, ppid, executable basename, service name), never a raw command line.
platform/git info records chip/core/memory/OS and repo revision + dirty paths; no hardware UUID, serial, or hostname.
